# The Grails plugins of this release of Grails: every plugin the framework's own build publishes, which list-plugins
# and plugin-info of the command line know without asking the network. A line is, with tabs between them:
#   group:artifact   the coordinates; the version is not here, it is the one the Grails BOM manages
#   name             the name people know the plugin by
#   description      one line that says what the plugin is for
#   documentation    the https address of its documentation, or empty
#   features         the features of the command line that add the plugin to an application, with commas, or empty
#   descriptor       the plugin class in the sources of the framework, by its path from the root of the repository
# BundledPluginsSpec holds this file to the sources: a plugin class of the framework without a line here, a line
# whose plugin class is gone, an artifact the Grails BOM does not manage and a feature that does not add the
# plugin each fail it. Add a line when the framework gets a plugin.
